class.name: NNHTNCompoundTask
class.brief_description: A high-level HTN goal that decomposes into one of its child [NNHTNMethod] approaches.
class.description: Represents an abstract goal in an HTN domain (such as "AttackEnemy" or "GetToSafety"). Give it one or more [NNHTNMethod] children describing alternative ways to accomplish the goal; during planning, the planner tries enabled methods in order (or by priority under ranked/cost policies) and backtracks if a method cannot be completed.
